hni_signals: Very strong leadership profile. Titled 'Director & Head of Department - Neurosurgery, Spine Surgery & ZAP-X Neuro Radiosurgery' on AIG's own Banjara Hills doctor page - a Director-level post plus ownership of a named radiosurgery programme. Practises across MULTIPLE AIG locations: AIG publishes separate doctor pages for him at Gachibowli and at Banjara Hills. Clinical lead for AIG's ZAP-X gyroscopic neuro-radiosurgery platform, a high-capex flagship technology; AIG's acquisition of ZAP-X was covered as 'AIG Hospitals to Bring ZAP-X to South India' (zapsurgical.com). Elite training: MCh Neurosurgery from AIIMS New Delhi (2002), MS General Surgery from VSS Institute of Medical Sciences Sambalpur (1998). Academic standing: teacher and examiner for the National Board (DNB), with more than 35 publications in peer-reviewed journals and textbook chapters. Career track through senior consultant posts at Kamineni Hospitals and then Apollo Hospitals Hyderabad (until Feb 2020) before joining AIG. Listed on the Government of India's Advantage Healthcare (healinindia.gov.in) directory of India-facing specialist consultants. Described as an expert and pioneer in endoscopic brain surgery. No publicly stated procedure volume found.

However his CURRENT AIG affiliation is confirmed by AIG itself on two of its own live pages (Gachibowli /doctor/dr-subodh-raju and Banjara Hills /banjara-hills/doctor/dr-subodh-raju, the latter carrying his Director & HOD title) AND independently by the Government of India's Advantage Healthcare directory, which lists him under 'Neuro Surgery / Spine Surgery in AIG Hospitals'. The employer is therefore not in dispute, hospital_profile is populated, and the band is High rather than Low.
